name: sendnow
description: Share documents as secure, trackable links, build data rooms, and see who viewed what.

interface.longDescription: SendNow lets you share confidential documents and data rooms right from ChatGPT, and see exactly who engaged with them. Upload documents and create secure share links in one step. Protect links with email verification, allowed-viewer lists, NDA sign-off, download blocking, watermarks, expiry dates and view caps. Build branded multi-document data rooms for fundraising, due diligence and client work. Check views, unique viewers, time spent and completion for every link, and tighten or revoke access anytime. SendNow only accesses documents in your connected account.
defaultPrompt: Share my pitch deck with downloads turned off
Create a data room for my Series A with email verification
Who viewed my deck this week and how long did they spend?

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the account's most recent documents with names and upload dates, newest first, plus the total document count.

positive.prompt: Check my SendNow plan and storage usage
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the active plan, document count and storage used versus the plan limit.

positive.prompt: Share Pitch Deck.pdf with downloads turned off and email verification on
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the settings, creates a link with downloads disabled and email verification on, and returns a share.sendnow.live/s/... URL.

positive.prompt: Create a data room called Series A Diligence with my pitch deck and email verification
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a data room with the pitch deck attached and email verification on, and returns its share.sendnow.live/m/... URL.

positive.prompt: Who viewed my pitch deck and how long did they spend?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns total views, unique viewers, average time spent and completion for Pitch Deck.pdf from the seeded viewer sessions.

review.commerce_description: SendNow does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release. Upload documents, create secure share links, build data rooms, and see who viewed what, right from ChatGPT. Fixes the OAuth resource configuration that blocked sign-in on the previous submission.
